; seccomp filter for arm64 (LEC SB-6), 64 instructions

(022) jeq      #0x6a           jt 61	jf 23         ; delete_module

(027) jeq      #0x109          jt 61	jf 28         ; open_by_handle_at
(028) jeq      #0x108          jt 61	jf 29         ; name_to_handle_at
(029) jeq      #0x59           jt 61	jf 30         ; acct
(030) jeq      #0xe0           jt 61	jf 31         ; swapon

(037) jeq      #0x1b1          jt 61	jf 38         ; fspick
(038) jeq      #0x1ad          jt 61	jf 39         ; move_mount
(039) jeq      #0x1ac          jt 61	jf 40         ; open_tree
(040) jeq      #0x1ba          jt 61	jf 41         ; mount_setattr
(041) jeq      #0x1d3          jt 61	jf 42         ; open_tree_attr
(042) jeq      #0xc6           jt 49	jf 43         ; socket
(043) jeq      #0xc7           jt 49	jf 44         ; socketpair
(044) jeq      #0x5c           jt 54	jf 45         ; personality

(046) ret      #0x7fff0000                         ; ALLOW
